note: SegWit share = extras.segwitTotalTxs / tx_count (authoritative, mempool.space block summary). Legacy = 100 - SegWit. Taproot = share of uniformly-sampled spends with a v1_p2tr (P2TR) input (180 sampled non-coinbase txs, 1 capture rounds, aggregated; labeled sampled, not exhaustive; P2SH-wrapped segwit counts as legacy). Effective TPS = total tx / (N blocks x avg block interval) from real blocks — NOT an invented constant; theoretical max 7 TPS kept only as a reference. Weight utilization = avg block weight / 4M WU.
